title: Decoding methods and what they do
summary: Match five ways to pick the next token with how each one chooses.

options.text: Always takes the single most likely token
Divides the logits before the softmax, which flattens the distribution and adds variety
Samples only among a fixed number of the most likely tokens
Samples from the smallest set of tokens whose probabilities add up to a threshold
Keeps several partial sequences and ranks them by total log-probability
Lowers the logits of tokens that already appeared
